metadata.description: Digital newspaper about Cuba and its communities. Investigation, features and analysis with editorial review.

nacional.name: National
nacional.description: News from Cuba and its public life, with verification and context.

internacional.name: International
internacional.description: What happens outside Cuba and how it affects its communities.

comunidades.name: Communities
comunidades.description: Stories and voices from the territories, inside and outside the island.

sociedad.name: Society
sociedad.description: Daily life, rights, health, education and migration.

economia.name: Economy
economia.description: Work, prices, services and household economy.

politica.name: Politics
politica.description: Public decisions, institutions and citizen participation.

cultura.name: Culture
cultura.description: Art, music, books and cultural memory.

opinion.name: Opinion
opinion.description: Signed analysis and columns, kept separate from news.

entrevistas.name: Interviews
entrevistas.description: Conversations with people who explain their time.

comunicados.name: Statements
comunicados.description: Declarations and positions from the publication.

home.leadBody: We are preparing the first edition with the standard that will guide the whole newspaper: verify before publishing, attribute every fact and correct in public.
home.leadNote: While there is no verified content, this front page shows no filler stories or sample texts presented as real.
home.latestEmpty: No stories yet. The first verified report will appear here.
home.noteEmpty: The front page will be filled with verified, dated reporting. Sample texts will not be presented as real stories.
home.sectionsIntro: The editorial structure is defined. Each section will open when it has content of its own.
home.radioBody: The audio archive will be added when episodes and authorised transcripts exist.
home.printBody: The digital archive will show every edition with its cover, metadata and download link.
home.newsletterBody: The newsletter will launch once email delivery and double opt-in are configured. No addresses will be collected before that review.
home.legalNotice: Site under development. Legal texts are drafts and require professional review.

section.emptyTitle: This section has no stories yet
section.emptyBody: When the newsroom publishes verified content in this section, it will appear here with its date, byline and tags.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search term
search.emptyTitle: Search will be available with the first content
search.emptyBody: The search index will open once there are published, reviewed stories.

about.title: About the newspaper
about.description: Institutional information about El Observador Cubano.
about.introBody: El Observador Cubano is being built as a digital home for community journalism: verified information, context and a voice for people inside and outside the island.
about.placeholderBody: This page will hold verified information about the editorial leadership, the team and the publication's mission. No names, titles or biographies will be published until their authorisation is confirmed.

principles.accuracy: Verification first and attribution of sources.
principles.independence: News, opinion and advertising kept separate.

radio.title: Radio
radio.description: Audio programmes and episodes from El Observador Cubano.
radio.emptyBody: Players will be enabled when programmes, episodes and reviewed transcripts exist. No audio will autoplay.

print.title: Print edition
print.emptyBody: Each future edition will show its number, date, page count, file size and a verified download link.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftBody: This text is a working basis. It must not be treated as a final policy until it has been reviewed by qualified legal counsel and published with an effective date.

principles.minimal: We collect only the data required for each purpose.
principles.analytics: Planned analytics are aggregate and use no tracking cookies.
principles.rights: Channels to access, correct and delete data will be documented.
principles.retention: Retention periods will be published with the final policy.

privacy.pending: The full version will be added before opening subscriber registration or any form that processes personal data.

footer.draftNotice: Site under development. Legal texts in draft.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
notFound.body: Check the address or return to the front page. If you followed an old link, the matching redirect will be added during migration.

errors.genericBody: We could not complete the operation. Please try again in a few minutes.
